audit.whatIsWrong: Cassiopeia wins 43.19% over 257 games but the chart handed her three stages and Annie none.
audit.why: Two of those rows do not survive the kit. Levels 4-5: Disintegrate refunds its mana cost on a kill on a 4s cooldown, so Annie never runs dry and your Tear lead buys no window. First item: Molten Shield is a 10s shield that absorbs the opening burst your item just paid for, so the spike does not hand you the stage.
audit.corrected: Rows 3 and 5 moved to Skill in both layers with rewritten whys. Row 6 left with Cassiopeia — sustained Twin Fang DPS genuinely outscales a burst-only kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no number, and the spike text pointed only at Tibbers.
audit.why: Disintegrate 4s, Incinerate 7s, Molten Shield 10s, Summon: Tibbers 130/115/100s against your 120/100/80s Gaze. Pyromania stocks after 4 casts and Annie 'begins the game and respawns with Pyromania available' — she has a stun at level 1.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, phases[0].why, phases[4].why and ahead.

audit.whatIsWrong: Molten Shield was never mentioned anywhere in the matchup, and the level-1 danger was described as generic poke.
audit.why: Molten Shield 'grants Annie or an ally a shield, a burst of Move Speed, and damages enemies who strike her with attacks or spells' on 10s — it absorbs your commit and punishes fang spam. Pyromania being pre-stocked at game start means level 1 already carries a hard stun.
audit.corrected: Shield folded into phases[5].why, spikes[2], dontsFull[2].d; the pre-stocked stun into phases[0].why, tldr and enemyWin.
